title: Brandon Sartor (multi-state sex trafficking)
summary: Brandon Sartor of Prince George's County, Maryland initially recruited each victim by falsely promising to help them make money. From December 2024 to April 2025 he then compelled them to have sex with as many as 10 men a day across Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Pennsylvania and South Carolina, seizing the money. DOJ says he used punching and hitting, threats to harm or kill victims or their families, and opioids that he gave and withheld so victims feared withdrawal. In August 2026 Sartor pleaded guilty in the Southern District of Florida to two counts of sex trafficking by force, fraud or coercion; sentencing was set for November 17, 2026, with a 15-year mandatory minimum.
